job: Choose a reporting period and what to compare it with.
purpose: The trigger of a date range that has a compare band: presets and a calendar, then Compared with Nothing, Previous period or Same period last year. The trigger shows the range and, muted, the comparison dates. Apply fires fd:change with { start, end, preset, compare }, where compare is null or { mode, start, end }.
useWhen: A report, chart or stats row shows a figure and how it changed against an earlier period.
Several screens share one period control.

avoidWhen.when: Only the period matters, with no comparison.
A fixed set of ranges and nothing custom.

states.name: no comparison
states.how: data-compare="none" or the Nothing radio; the trigger's compare label is empty and hidden

states.name: pending
states.how: data-pending in the calendar after the first click of a custom range

parts.role: On the fd-filter that triggers the popover.
The muted "vs" part of the trigger; carries data-fd-daterange-compare-label.

keyboard.does: In the calendar, move by day and week.
Move by month; with Shift, by year.
In the Compared with radios, move between modes.
